k: Gravemouth inhales. A hundred buried voices fall silent...
src: 'Gravemouth inhales. A hundred buried voices fall silent...'

k: The Choirmother raises her baton for the final verse...
src: 'The Choirmother raises her baton for the final verse...'

k: She holds out her hand. Do not take it...
src: 'She holds out her hand. Do not take it...'

k: Light gathers at the orrery's center...
The Iron Duke takes a two-handed stance.
src: 'The Iron Duke takes a two-handed stance.'

k: The Duke raises his greatsword high...
The bell tolls, and a note takes shape!
src: 'The bell tolls, and a note takes shape!'

k: The great bell swings back, back, back...
src: 'The great bell swings back, back, back...'

k: The Last Bloom drinks the whole garden's voice!
src: 'The Last Bloom drinks the whole garden\'s voice!'

k: A thousand petal-mouths open at once...
The Bane of Harrow roars. Its wounds close!
src: 'The Bane of Harrow roars. Its wounds close!'

k: It drags itself up for one last killing lunge...
src: 'It drags itself up for one last killing lunge...'

k: The Bane lowers its head. Its jaws unhinge...
src: 'The Bane lowers its head. Its jaws unhinge...'

k: The Black Star swallows the light. Time slows.
src: 'The Black Star swallows the light. Time slows.'

k: The Black Star collapses inward — everything is pulled toward it!
src: 'The Black Star collapses inward — everything is pulled toward it!'

k: Every light in the sky bends toward the Black Star...
src: 'Every light in the sky bends toward the Black Star...'

k: Bounties pay better than honest work. Also, they are honest work.
src: 'Bounties pay better than honest work. Also, they are honest work.'

k: Brackenmoor's east of here. Take the gate and mind your ankles.
src: 'Brackenmoor\'s east of here. Take the gate and mind your ankles.'

k: The old man built this Lodge with his hands. Harrow. Something killed him in a hollow south of the moor.
src: 'The old man built this Lodge with his hands. Harrow. Something killed him in a hollow south of the moor.'

k: Adelind won't post it. Says we're not good enough. She's right, which is the annoying part.
src: 'Adelind won\'t post it. Says we\'re not good enough. She\'s right, which is the annoying part.'

k: Bombs, arrows, and things that go in wounds. Buy something.
src: 'Bombs, arrows, and things that go in wounds. Buy something.'

k: Everything's twice the price and half the quality. That's the apocalypse for you.
src: 'Everything\'s twice the price and half the quality. That\'s the apocalypse for you.'

k: Tell Mara the bread is in the oven. Tell her it's her turn to burn it.
src: 'Tell Mara the bread is in the oven. Tell her it\'s her turn to burn it.'

k: It doesn't hurt. I promise. Go on, go — I'll catch up.
src: 'It doesn\'t hurt. I promise. Go on, go — I\'ll catch up.'

k: Did the sun come up? Somebody tell me the sun came up.
src: 'Did the sun come up? Somebody tell me the sun came up.'

k: I should have called you back. Every day, I should have called you back.
src: 'I should have called you back. Every day, I should have called you back.'

k: The boy's name is Tam. Look after him. He's scared of the dark.
src: 'The boy\'s name is Tam. Look after him. He\'s scared of the dark.'

k: Bounties for monsters too much for a village.
src: 'Bounties for monsters too much for a village.'

k: At low tide, a causeway rises to a dome older than the Lanterns.
src: 'At low tide, a causeway rises to a dome older than the Lanterns.'

k: An abandoned Dawnguard fort. Sir Aldous's old command.
src: 'An abandoned Dawnguard fort. Sir Aldous\'s old command.'

k: The Hunters' Lodge survived. Some of it.
src: 'The Hunters\' Lodge survived. Some of it.'

k: A bell-tower hanging upside-down under a shard. It rings on its own.
src: 'A bell-tower hanging upside-down under a shard. It rings on its own.'

k: White flowers that speak the last words of the dead.
src: 'White flowers that speak the last words of the dead.'

k: It does not shine. It takes.
One is a nuisance. There is never one.
src: 'One is a nuisance. There is never one.'

k: Every spring the kelp beds wash up on Lanternfall's shore. This spring, some of the kelp walked.
src: 'Every spring the kelp beds wash up on Lanternfall\'s shore. This spring, some of the kelp walked.'

k: Its glow soothes everything that lives in the caves, so they keep coming back. Put it out first.
src: 'Its glow soothes everything that lives in the caves, so they keep coming back. Put it out first.'

k: Fishermen lost in the dark follow its light, thinking it is a boat. It is not a boat.
src: 'Fishermen lost in the dark follow its light, thinking it is a boat. It is not a boat.'

k: Wold wolves run in threes because the fourth is always watching. When it marks you, the others come.
src: 'Wold wolves run in threes because the fourth is always watching. When it marks you, the others come.'

k: It spins between the wheat rows and waits for the harvest. Lately it has stopped waiting.
src: 'It spins between the wheat rows and waits for the harvest. Lately it has stopped waiting.'

k: A thistledown seed that caught a little Gloam and a great many opinions. It hurries its friends along.
src: 'A thistledown seed that caught a little Gloam and a great many opinions. It hurries its friends along.'

k: Quick hands and quicker feet. Fell it before it runs and you get your purse back.
src: 'Quick hands and quicker feet. Fell it before it runs and you get your purse back.'

k: Aurenne lights a thousand hearths a night. Something has been nesting in the flues.
src: 'Aurenne lights a thousand hearths a night. Something has been nesting in the flues.'

k: It points wherever the wind is about to go. Then it goes there first.
src: 'It points wherever the wind is about to go. Then it goes there first.'

k: It lived in the Halcyon's engines and guards the wreck the way a dog guards a bone. It throws its shell over anything hurt.
src: 'It lived in the Halcyon\'s engines and guards the wreck the way a dog guards a bone. It throws its shell over anything hurt.'

k: Lanternfall's gulls in the last week. Their wings smoulder, and they have stopped being afraid of anything.
src: 'Lanternfall\'s gulls in the last week. Their wings smoulder, and they have stopped being afraid of anything.'

k: The last lamps of Lanternfall burn too bright and too long. Some of them have wandered off.
src: 'The last lamps of Lanternfall burn too bright and too long. Some of them have wandered off.'
